newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan overnight rates 3.00 pct to 4.00 pct.
newsitem.headline: Jordan overnight rates 3.00 pct to 4.00 pct.

text.p: Overnight rates on the Jordanian dinar were steady in a 3.00-4.00 percent range on Monday in a market still awash with liquidity, traders said.
"There are dollar dinar swaps, repurchase accords and maturing CD's that are all adding liquidity to an already liquid market," said one dealer.
Maturing CDs (Certificates of Deposit) this week released more cash into the market than was drained by the latest 15 million dinar issue, dealers said.
This weeks's fall means that Jordan's overnight rates have fallen to less than half of average levels just 10 days ago.
